name: Semi-trailing arm rear, Skoda 130 RS, measured (Vondrak 2013, Brno)
source: Zdenek Vondrak, 'Konstrukcni navrh uhlove kyvadlove napravy' (Mechanical Design of Semi-Trailing Arm Suspension), Master's thesis, Brno University of Technology, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering, Institute of Automotive Engineering, 2013. Supervisor Ing. Petr Hejtmanek. Vehicle: Skoda 130 RS racing car rear axle. https://dspace.vut.cz/server/api/core/bitstreams/f3edc79f-1eab-4307-bfb1-9e6ea733b1a0/content. Left points of Tab.1 (photogrammetry, GOM TRITOP) at the measured, fully drooped pose; x is moved to the hub face point. The wheel offset is not given (wheel center = hub face point, assumed); radius 265 mm (thesis p.22). Masses and rates are assumed.

spring.note: coil-over on the damper points; rates assumed
